data.description:
Recycledin is a small-scale plastic recycling studio producing home design products, accessories and solutions for businesses at a competitive price. We collect washed up beach waste and post-consumer plastics, wash and sort the plastic by type and colour, shred it, create recycled plastic sheets, design products and precision cut them using a CNC frazer. We also work with plastic bags and make flower pots, wallets, party buntings, shower curtains and anything else you can imagine.

You can purchase both our raw materials (clean bottle caps, shredded HDPE, plastic sheets) as well as ready and custom products and solutions.

All of our plastic is collected in the Mediterranean, made in the EU and shipped with tracking. VAT invoices available upon request.

data.description: Recycling Village is a brand that works on plastic waste recycling, based in Desa Air Naningan, Lampung. Initiated since October 2021, Recycling Village have managed to save 1000 kgs of plastic waste from ending up in landfills and transform them into 2000 pieces of fashion accessories.  Recycling Village aims to solve two key issues in Indonesia, the plastic waste abundance on the land and the low number of women participations in the workforce. To tackle this problem, Recycling Village decided to open its first workshop in the middle of suburb area of Desa Air Naningan. By opening their workshop, Recycling Village provides waste bank for the people of Desa Air Naningan to responsibly sort and collect their household plastic waste.  Recycling Village also believes that all women should be able to feel like they are capable, important, and empowered. Recycling Village work closely with the women of Desa Air Naningan on their production activity. Every item is exquisitely handmade by the women of Desa Air Naningan with extra dose of love and hope for a better world, a world where both nature and living beings thrive.  This 2023, Recycling Village is collaborating with WWF to expand the business impact in Jakarta by empowering 16 underrepresented women.
data.title: Recycling Village

data.description:
Je m'appelle Lucas, je suis l'un des fondateur et aujourd'hui leader du projet Recylab.

Le Recylab est né au sein du Hackerspace de Liège en Belgique. 
Il se trouve maintenant implanté en France suite à notre choix de vie, de changer de pays.

L'équipe est aujourd'hui réduite à moi et ma compagne. Nous aménageons aujourd'hui nos nouveaux locaux pour relancer le projet de plus belle. Nous serions ravis de recevoir de l'aide, sachant que notre point faible est la communication et les réseaux sociaux (avis aux web développeurs et reporter dans l'âme).

Recylab est né bercé par le milieu maker et le monde du numérique. 
Pour cette raison nous somme sensible à la question des déchets d'impression 3D qui n'ont aucune filière de recyclage. 
Nous collectons tout types de déchets d'impressions dans la mesure ou ils sont trié par type de plastique, chose très importante comme tous bon PP member le sait. 

A l'heure actuelle le PLA que nous recyclons est transformé en bijoux par ma compagne (check Horizonbijoux). Mais nous avons de nombreuses autres applications en tête, à suivre...

Nous disposons d'un broyeur V2 et d'une presse d'injection Arbor un peux améliorée. Le prochain objectif est l'extrudeuse et la station de lavage !
data.title: Recylab

data.description:
We are a startup mixed space based in Tangier, Morocco. We exist to see mindsets changed in regards to how we use and discard plastics. Alongside running our workspace, we provide training and sell machinery for entrepreneurs to join in the effort across the country. 

As the first Precious Plastic workspace in Morocco we have spent time building relationships with other local businesses to help in supplying us with components for the precious plastics machines. We are hope to run training courses in 2022 and be available to supply machinery to other entrepreneurs looking to join the Precious Plastic community.

We are proactive in building local partnerships with businesses, restaurants and schools that operate as collection hubs as well as places to share the bigger vision of caring for our planet. 

We hold regular cleanup events as a way to grow awareness of what we do and get other people involved in cleaning up the beautiful country that we live in.
data.title: Redeeming Plastics

data.description: The Integrated Waste Management Facility (IWMF) is the community-based facility developed based on the approved plans discussed with the government counterpart. The IWMF is part of the Recycling Promotion Pilot (RPP) project which was initiated by the National Directorate Urban Organization under Directorate General Administration and Decentralization of Ministry State Administration (MSA) in partnership with UNDP Timor-Leste. The Facility is served as treatment spaces from regular collection by waste shorting collector, a core treatment technology which includes composting and community garden, and shop for selling recycling/upcycling and reusable products. The IWMF is equipped with the following equipment and facilities: (1).Waste collection: a tricycle will collect separated wastes from households and business in traget area. (2).Waste storage: a shipping container to temporarily store the waste to be recycled or to be sold to other companies/businesse. (3).Recycling workshop: 1 set of Precious Plastic Machines (Shredder Machine, Extrussion Machine, Injection Machine and Compression Machine) to shred plastic wastes and transform into new product such as paving & flowerpot (4)Composting facility: a Bio Box to recover compost and gas out of green wastes, and natural composting space. (5).Green space: gardening using organic fertilizer, and (6). Green Kiosk: a shop to market biodegradable as well as recycled and second-hands products

data.description: ReMade Community lab è un’associazione di promozione sociale che ha lo scopo di diffondere il pensiero ecologico e la cultura digitale. Mettiamo in atto processi di micro produzione a partire dai rifiuti urbani in plastica utilizzando tecniche di riciclo a bassa complessità e di fabbricazione digitale.  Sperimentiamo per ridurre l’impatto ambientale della gestione dei rifiuti urbani concentrando in una sola unità organizzativa le fasi di raccolta, riciclo e produzione per un modello di prossimità. I prodotti realizzati nel laboratorio sono concepiti attraverso un processo creativo che parte dalla scelta e la rielaborazione di segni del territorio, per contribuire alla costruzione di nuove identità positive. Puntiamo alla sensibilizzazione della comunità coinvolgendo abitanti e commercianti nella raccolta e attivando workshop e percorsi di formazione per la trasmissione di competenze nel campo della digital manufacturing come strumento per facilitare lo sviluppo di nuove forme di imprenditorialità nell’ambito della green e circular economy.

data.description:
We're a couple of teachers from Belgium planning to move to Sidi Kaouki near Essaouira in Morocco. We already finished our house and are right now planning some tiny houses and tents for touristic rental. Sidi kaouki is a legendary surfing hotspot with great vibes. The population is a mixture of the  local Berber-population, crazy surfing people from all over the world and many expats from everywhere.
The village is just at the beginning of getting good infrastructure (water, electricity, roads...) and some hotels and many Guesthouses are popping up in the surroundings.
Sidi Kaouki wants to get an official label of "Ecovillage" and many poeple are already for years in organisations like the Surfrider Foundation. They're cleaning up the beaches and the woods. They also do a great job in the local schools and take every possible chance to inform and involve as much the local population as the tourists.

We think that this place is like predestined to run a recycling workspace. 
The problem is daily visible at the beaches and due to the strong winds, plastic rubbish is everywhere.
Where else than there would it be necessary to help getting rid of this huge problem and to cooperate with others that also just want to make the world a little better?
We want to produce surfing supplies, small items destinated to tourists and exclusive pieces of furniture.
We're happy to be a part of the prescious-community and are looking forward for good cooperations and even new friends.
See you...

data.description: Residuo Cero Lab is the first creative and artistic space of sustainable cocreation, dedicated to educate, inspire and promote actions on responsible consumption, zero waste and precious plastic. Our Lab is located in San Luis, an emerging artistic neighborhood in the vibrant district of Teusaquillo in Bogotá. We aim to build a learning community around precious plastic and zero waste lifestyle and philosophy. All this by offering open activities to citizens in our lab and also increasing environmental awareness among our partners and customers.  Latin Latas, Círcula and Ecoworks are the three associates that operate the Lab. Latin Latas is an artistic company that inspires people to change their consumption habits, through a wide range of activities such as workshops, live music shows with professional instruments made out of waste, inspirational talks and long term projects in vulnerable communities. Círcula is a sustainable design laboratory, dedicated to create significant and unique products, using post-consumer plastic as main raw material. Ecoworks is a business commited to work for the social and economic inclusion of the waste picker population in Colombia. We all believe that changing the world is possible, one step at a time.
data.title: Residuo Cero Lab // Latin Latas

data.description:
Hi, we are Michael and Kokoy, cofounders of RESIKLO.

All the small talks about starting a company/business started early 2019. We immediately agreed on making a manufacturing business but we have no idea yet on what we will be making. We would pray and throw ideas daily on what product to make. Then we stumbled upon Precious Plastics. Their machines immediately caught our attention and we joined in to their goal to help our community in recycling plastic waste.

We committed full time in starting the business and making the machines last January 2021. We finished the prototype of the Shredding Machine on February 1. Additionally, you can see from our early postings, we also made some equipment and tools from scrap materials around our area which brings out the restorers / recyclers in us.
We have a long way to go and despite what is happening around us, we can say that God is graciously providing for what we need and we are ever grateful to Him for that. Our ultimate goal on why we are doing what we are doing is to give honor and glory to our Maker, to our God. We are excited to see what God is planning for us through this journey and constantly praying that we would reflect His character in every action and decision we make.
We are looking forward to your suggestions, comments and constructive criticism through this page on any products we will be posting.

Cheers,
Your Resiklo

data.description:
My name is Robbie and I am a Sustainable Technology graduate from Appalachian State University and an East AVL native. My goal is to make the plastic in the city of Asheville a precious resource again, for the environment and for the community. Especially following the severing of cooperation with China, who was the largest recyclables processing partner for the US. The recycling industry needs people to do the actual processing and production with the material that is still continuously being collected and sorted.  I'm constructing a mixed workspace for the Asheville area that reduces our city's plastic impact. I am also developing a educational program for the community that will benefit people with resources, business with evaluations, collection and sorting with quality and the city of Asheville in reaching their goal of zero waste! I'm coming to terms with what all this encompasses and would love help in making this a reality!

Some details about my workshop/progress:
- It has been one year since I began this journey.
- I am currently a one person team, but could see so much benefit from having others interested achieving these goals.
- I am working on a pedal powered shredder
- I have a solar foam cutter for doing lost foam casting.
- There is an electric foundry under construction for creating aluminum castings
- I have a heat press for creating sheets and Ts
- I'm eager to create long lasting and useful products for schools and community projects that engage people in learning and the environment via school and garden supplies.
data.title: Robbie's Renewed Recycling

We got the source of plastic collaborate with "Waste Bank" in Surabaya and Lombok and sometimes we got the flakes from scavanger community in East Java area. 
Many people in Indonesia still throwing their trash everywhere. We want to explore more techniques to make beautiful and useful product, so we can educate people and show them that their trash is a precious material. Hope it can change the habit to not throw trash everywhere and empowering people and woman in Indonesia who in charge in organizing house's waste.
data.title: Robries Gallery

data.description:
Hello my name is Joschka from Germany :) 

I started 3d-printing automotive spare parts with my resin printer a few years ago.
At that time, it was a hobby, which turned into a side business roeben-3d.de... (I initially planned to stop here!)

As I went along printing parts, more and more dirty IPA and empty resin bottles accumulated.
In Germany, those are considered dangerous waste and need to go to a specialized and certified recycling facility.

To my surprise, I could not find a facility for the typical amounts from small and medium companies or makers!
And if some company offered to collect them, they just dump and burn it! But thats not what one likes, who studied Environmental and Recycling engineering...

So I started to develop my own process with 100% recycling and 0% waste!

The material flow from resin and IPA waste is as follows:  

Dirty IPA is turned into 99,9% IPA again (to be used again in resin 3d printing as a cleaning solvent)
PE from the Resin bottles and IPA-containers is recycled to make new containers (for example IPA)
Resin is turned into PMMA-plastic, where we currently exploring opportunities and seekind collab partners to make new products out of it! 

Currently its just me, but I hope to find more people not only in germany, but EU and worldwide!

Our grandparants have been full of lead, our parents full of asbestos and our generation is full of (micro)plastic.
I like the mission of preciousplastics and hope to offer my fair share to the plastic mess on our world!
data.title: Roeben_Resin_IPA_Recycling

data.description:
When Ryan first looked at what local businesses and families of a town without garbage/recycling collection sent to landfill simply because of convienience it is when he first started on the idea that is now becoming Resource Recovery Zones (RRZ).
RRZ currently only has one location that we are working n making as many mistakes as possible in before we start branching out to become a collection and processing network.
We take on board most all things recyclable whether we can make money from it or not so long as we have a way of getting it used rather than ending up in landfill.
Some of the things we take:
Any form of metals or metal bearing products,
Electronic Waste,
Most plastics (for example we take all things like PET and HDPE, we will take limited quantities of things like expanded PS which we pass on to be used generally in mail packaging.)
Paper, Cardboard etc. (including having converted one of the local Cafes to compostable take away containers and cups)
Compostable food waste
Some green waste (generally if it is small enough for us to mulch in a small shredder and it will stay dead and not propogate after mulching it is good).
We have one 1000L Bin located at the top of the driveway at 25 Harland Rd, Mount Glorious QLD for general household recyclables and electronics which is accessible seven days a week with room for a car to pull completly off the road. 
For large amounts or to drop off green waste send us an email with your details and we will get in contact to arrange for us to pickup or a time for you to drop off where we can process it straight away.
data.title: RRZ

data.description:
Saboga Bonita is the first Recycling Eco-Center in the beautiful Saboga Island, in the Pearl Island archipelago in Panama. The space was created by Ocean Legacy Foundation and the Sailing Club Panama, and it is currently run by the Sailing Club team. We started in 2020 with an idea and today is a reality that makes us so happy.

Its propose is to serve as an educational space for the community of the island. On one hand, we do regularly beach clean-ups with kids from the community and then we do a recycling workshop with them. On the other hand, there are currently 4 people of the community working on cutting, cleaning, and making products with plastic. In this place magic happens!

Currently the space has a shredder machine, an extruder machine and two paninis machines. With this we are able to make nice jewelry (neckless, brazaletes and earrings) and cute baskets made of 100% recycled plastic from the Saboga beaches. We are also able to work with other NGOs or projects that need plastic for their own projects, so we organize beach clean-ups, for example.

If you want to visit the space, do a workshop with us (individual or a family, company or school group), buy any product or volunteer with us, please reach out, we would love to hear from you!
data.title: Saboga Bonita

data.description:
I studied electro-mechanical engineering and Interior design after that. I have been working with metal my entire life since my father is a blacksmith and metal construction worker. I have created an injection molding machine 2 years ago just before moving to London. Now I am looking to sell this Adjustable Height Injection molder since it's just sitting here in Belgium not serving a purpose.
I'm in need of a capital injection into my U.K based Ltd and looking to sell this injection crane, CAD files, and furniture designs created with this injection crane.

I created this machine intending to inject recycled plastic at different heights.
I created this one with the Precious Plastic-type in the back of my head but thought it could use an upgrade due to the fixed height.
This could be used to inject plastic in a pre-assembled stainless steel mold combined with CNC cut plywood pieces to create the recycled plastic joints for tables, chairs, stools, etc etc.

The Crane just needs to be wired properly but is ready to use as seen in the pictures.

I'm selling the actual Injection Crane, all CAD drawings, and additional furniture Designs to start producing stools, chairs, and tables.
If you have any questions about the price, dimensions, etc please contact me at your convenience.

Purchase inquiries only, please.

Sauvage Méditerranée is an NGO whose purpose is to show people that we make value out of rubbish picked up on beaches. 
We are equipped with 2 shredders (one of them is manual), an oven plus an hydraulic press, 2 CNC, an extruder and finally 2 injection machines. These machines allow us to show people how to transform plastic with ease and costlessly. We welcome classrooms, companies, and passionate people in our workshop or directly in their place with our fully-equipped truck. 
Since we work with almost 30 NGOs along the méditerranean sea - which clean beaches and give us their thrash - we redistribute 10% of our benefits to them.

data.description:
We are an European family living in Phuket, Thailand, since August 2018. While enjoying these amazing landscapes, our awareness about plastic pollution grew every other day, and we decided to start our family-run plastic recycling project under the name of SaveUsFromPlastics. 
The Precious Plastic platform helped a lot to learn about plastics and how to reuse trash plastic. We invested in a Precious Plastic shredder and an injection machine. And together with a designer and a mold studio (both with experience in Precious Plastic), we developed our first useful product, a sea turtle holder for phones, glasses, some stationery, or simply for decoration. 
Recently, we got our second mold, a shark cup. This new item allows you to put some stationery, a toothbrush, or a small plant in it. 
Our aim as SaveUsFromPlastics is to keep collecting trash HDPE plastic bottle lids from beaches and other landfills and convert them into new useful products in the shape of some endangered marine animals located in Thailand.
data.title: SaveUsFromPlastics

data.description: We are tackling two global problems simultaneously: Plastic pollution and extreme poverty. We initiate events where the local population in India can pay for hot meals with plastic bottles. At the same time, they are made aware of environmental issues such as plastic pollution.   First and foremost, we are dedicated to the United Nations Development Goals 1(No Poverty) and 12(Sustainable Production and Consumption). Our vision is to create a self-functioning cycle in which we process the collected plastic bottles into new products and reintegrate them into the production chain through sales.    * How we do it: "Think globally and act locally."  In India, we create monthly events where the local population can exchange 20 plastic bottles for a warm meal. Plastic serves as currency and is exchanged for meals provided by the local team on site. We contribute to the solution of plastic pollution by giving plastic a value. We further process the collected plastic into beautiful and useful products to close the loop. In 2023, we Inaugurated our upcycling factory; by March 2024, once we have the license for the machine, we will recycle the plastic bottles.   At the same time, we engage local people by creating jobs for our event organization and in an upcycling factory.  Our Founder, Shakti Yadav, Contacted the Founders in Switzerland to implement the concept in their country because they were convinced from the beginning that it would work in their communities after watching a post on Instagram where he saw that people in Nicaragua were Exchanging Plastic Bottles for a warm meal.    Till now, Buy Food with Plastic India alone has rescued 50,000+ Plastic Bottles, Educated 500+ Children and adults, and reached out to more than 500+ Families; globally, We rescued 2,05,728 Plastic Bottles, 80.932 Meals Distributed, 57 jobs created, 236 members worldwide.
data.title: Buy Food with Plastic India

We are a HDPE & LDPE collection point.  

Our family run team and the 80 children associated with the childcare centre in this area are keen on collecting as much HDPE (#2) and LDPE (#4) plastic as possible! 

As you collect more plastic and drop it off at our collection point, you will see our collection point grow! More bins, bigger bins and rumour has it that a whimsical octopus is eager to move into this space!  You will also find information in this space about Precious Plastics, different types of plastics and some of our local community members. 

The plastic is regularly taken out of the bins, sorted, washed and transported to our nearby storage warehouse. 

The plastic collected will be transported and provided to other members in the community for recycling (e.g. Ocean Crusaders).

Environmental education: SGGC conducts educational programs for community members on topics such as environmental conservation, waste management, and health and hygiene. Livelihoods: SGGC supports community members with skills training and small business development to help them improve their livelihoods. Water and sanitation: SGGC works to improve access to clean water and sanitation in slums by building latrines, wells, and community bathrooms.

data.description:
Recycling plastic into new products to support arts and sustainability projects in Penrhys and across northern Rhondda since 2021. Our machinery was designed by Precious Plastic, and is an open-source resource aimed at communities globally to take control and create local benefit from this undervalued resource. 

We have a shredder, injection machine and extruder. Our sheet press has been stuck in Russia since the beginning of the war with Ukraine so we have been making do with some T-shirt sublimation machines while we wait. We make earrings, coasters, beams, furniture items and recently began 3d printing. 
Our mission is to unite individuals and local businesses in the Mid to Upper Rhondda Valleys around the issue of plastic pollution.
We inspire people to take action themselves through our donation scheme where anyone can drop off end-of-life plastics to be recycled into new and unique products. And our recycling workshops help engage and share knowledge with communities.

 

Through our inclusive art workshops, we inspire participants to redefine their perspective on plastic waste and its potential uses. Art can connect us through creativity without barriers and evolve our way of thinking and how we view the world.

​

Our valued partnerships with local businesses provide an opportunity to see their plastic waste transformed into new useful things whilst diverting plastic from landfill.
It’s not just about plastic!

We want to see if we can create a company that works in a different way, striving for inclusive practice that goes beyond the required, learning from existing best practices and challenging the way things are normally done.

 

We have a base in Penrhys at the former Buffs social club and over the next few years we will develop this site into a centre for arts, sustainability, research and most importantly, community.
data.title: Soaring Supersaurus

data.description:
Social Waste Management SA is an independent organization, passionate about conserving the environment and improving the waste infrastructure in South Africa. 


We are a community driven project called Social Waste Management SA, from Kwa-Zulu Natal, South Africa. We offer free recycling training, infrastructure and collection to households, schools, business and NGOs. We have managed to divert tons of recyclables, food and other valuable resources from landfill, this is where we create value through "waste". We are just over 6 months young and have made a significant impact in this short space of time. We have also been recognized by local newspapers, 8 articles presented by 4 newspapers and 1 digital magazine. 

We offer free reliable collection of recyclables every week.
We offer free door-to-door training on correct recycling procedures.
We have two drop-off centers for recyclables in Amanzimtoti. One at Doonside Rd in Doonside and the other at Nyati Road, Athlone Park. 
We provide recycle bags, bins and containers.
We provide affordable garden products and services that support our initiatives.

When we started our project in May, 2019, we were collecting black refuse bags from households on refuse collection day just to recover the few uncontaminated materials that we could still recover and also diving into the local dumps to discover what could be recycled and this helped us to create solutions. We are now at the point where we see more recycling bags than black bags on refuse day. 


We have managed to educate many households on improved recycling methods and it has made recycling more possible. 


We have unfortunately received notice from our local government to stop our operations due to us operating from our household. We only have a Ford Bantam bakkie and can not afford to keep our project running as we do not make money from what we do, we do this from the passion and love we have for our environment and people. We have an urgent need to grow our capacity and to continue with our operations, so we are requesting you to help us raise capital to purchase new land, new vehicles, new equipment to process the recyclables and equipment for our street collectors. We believe in this model and by your act of kindness, you will help us take one step closer to installing kids swop shop facilities, additional buy back centers, waste to energy and many more other exciting projects that we believe will roll out on a global scale.


We encourage you to get in contact with us to find out more. 


Thank you and best regards,


SOCIAL WASTE MANAGEMENT SA
"TOGETHER, WE CAN MAKE A DIFFERENCE
data.title: Social Recycling & Waste Management SA

data.description:
Aloha, 

My name is Todd & I am a machinist & welder that has been in the industry for 10+ years. Since 2019 I started my own company here on the beautiful Big Island of Hawaii. Most of my work consists of building decorative gate's, ranch modular pen's for cattle and various other life stock, heavy machinery repair's ie. bull dozers, tractor's, backo's, skid steer's, & excavator's, power plant repair work, & various other structural, high pressure vessel building's / tank's. 

I was recently asked if I would be interested in building one of your shredder's for a client of mine that wants to start a recycling operation, in which I was happy to agree to. I have a machinist/welding educational background & have attended our local trades school in pursuit of 2 associate degree's in welding, machining, and industrial mechanic's back in 2012 @ Hawaii Community College here on the island of Hawaii. 

I have a love & deep passion for fabrication of anything metallurgic in nature & since being introduced to precious plastic's, now have the drive to assist & involve myself in the creation of the machines necessary for the recycling process in creating new from old to help aid in the effort of saving our planet. 

I am looking forward to constructing my first machine very soon & hopefully many more to come after, including pre fabricated parts to offer to other's that are interested in building their own machine for the same purpose. 

Thank you precious plastic's for this wonderful opportunity to be able to be involved in something bigger than me and to be able to help other's also join in on the recycling & production movement.
data.title: SouthernCross808

data.description: Stichting Sparkling Plastic is een open werkplaats in Den Bosch waar op een duurzame, educatieve,en creatieve manier hard plastic afval gerecycled wordt. Samen met studenten, kunstenaars en andere creatievelingen zoeken we naar duurzame toepassingen voor gerecycled plastic, Onze werkplaats maakt experimenteren mogelijk. .Wat we ook belangrijk vinden is om met name jongeren actief te betrekken bij het plasticprobleem. Zij zijn de toekomst en daar zit ook de energie en de kans om anders met een onderwerp als plastic om te gaan. Want eerlijk is eerlijk: de  generatie vóór hen laat het wel een beetje afweten. Tevens gezocht ! : Duurzaamheid makers Wil jij: -	De wereld meer duurzaam en mooier maken -	Plastic afval een duurzame toepassing geven -	Creatieve geesten helpen duurzame oplossingen te maken  Wij kunnen jouw hulp goed gebruiken.  Wij zoeken mensen die actief willen bijdragen aan een meer duurzame wereld en oplossingen willen maken van plastic afval. Specifieke opleiding en ervaring is niet noodzakelijk. Maar altijd welkom.  Ben jij meer thuis in een werkplaats om dingen te maken en machines te bedienen? Ben je meer thuis op kantoor voor het beheer van website en social media? Ben je meer thuis in het organiseren en zorgen dat er oplossingen er komen?  Dan willen wij graag kennismaken met jou!
data.title: Sparkling Plastic

data.description:
Studio Wilks is primarily an artist studio focused on creating participatory sculptural work that strives to inspire a new consciousness regarding the stewardship of our home, planet earth.

Our community engagement takes many different forms. 
We are honored to be the 'workspace' of Precious Plastics LA and host meet-ups of like-minded, passionate people where we discuss plastic pollution issues, get hands-on with the machines, explore community sustainability goals and have project  presentations. We create workshops that inspire schools to engage in plastic recycle activism and offer mentoring to those who are creating their own in-house recycling programs. We attend and present at various grass roots events and festivals.
We also offer in-studio machine time and guidance to artists who are exploring recycled plastic in their art.
data.title: Studio Wilks

data.description: Fondée en 2019, DK Clean Up s'engage à nettoyer les plages et les milieux naturels du Dunkerquois en luttant contre la pollution plastique. Notre mission repose sur trois piliers fondamentaux : la sensibilisation pour réduire le plastique à la source, les actions de ramassage qui nous permettent d'agir concrètement sur le terrain et la revalorisation des déchets via le studio payëtte.  Ce qui distingue DK Clean Up, c'est avant tout la détermination de nos bénévoles et l'esprit de groupe qui les anime. Leur engagement inébranlable nous pousse à aller toujours plus loin pour rendre les milieux naturels du Dunkerquois plus propres. Ensemble, nous souhaitons donner l'exemple et construire un avenir meilleur pour notre communauté. En plus de nos actions de sensibilisation et de ramassage, nous sommes engagés dans un projet de recyclage visant à donner une nouvelle vie au plastique collecté lors de nos interventions. Notre objectif est de créer une traçabilité pour cette matière et de la revaloriser de manière responsable.Nous collaborons avec des entreprises locales pour récupérer leur plastique, offrant ainsi une solution de recyclage à l'échelle régionale.
data.title: Studio Paÿette

data.description:
We are a sustainablity oriented company, working in the community to help residences and local companies find solutions for their recycled goods. Our goal is to help create and provide local solutions along with helping people create local jobs. 
We are presently shredding number 7 (PLA) for further processing in an extruder, then to use with our 3D Printer, and eventually to supply local printers with shredded product. 

A larger shredder for denser plastics such as HDPE is being built now, for processing in the near future.

The goal will to make use of as much recycled plastic in the community as possible, to supply local printers with shredded plastics; all while reaping the benefits of a more sustainable and resilient community, and a smaller carbon footprint.

We will also be 3D printing replacement goods and parts for the local community, and in the near future some scanning, effectively building database of STL's.

We are also working with the local High School to help students learn about 3D printing, and teaching how to live in a more sustainbable manner.

Contact us with any questions you have.

data.description:
Plastic waste has become a global topic of discussion with more companies producing it and fewer companies engaging in recycling activities.

This is sparked the surge of individuals and small scale enterprises in the field of recreational and beneficial plastic recycling.

*SWK TSADIDEY FOUNDATION * is a Plastic Waste Recycling Art Center and NGO established in honour of our Hero, Father, Friend and Family Icon to promote sustainable energy, affordable housing and furnishing as well as Creative and Innovative Art Ideas using recycled Plastic waste for generations yet unborn.

Our desire is to forster the achievement of 7 of the 17 Global Goals in Ghana and beyond!!

We also seek to promote true education by showcasing and selling the books written  by our Father, Friend, Hero and Family Icon the Late Simon Wilberforce Kwami Tsadidey!!

We believe that if Plastic  recycling will be effective the youth and children of this generation must be given the necessary skills, training and education in the area of Plastic Waste Recycling and that's why we have taken it upon ourselves.

However, we cannot do this alone and therefore call on all and sundry to support no matter how little or huge in kind, cash, logistics or even just plastics. 

Thank you and God bless you for your concern.
data.title: SWK TSADIDEY FOUNDATION

data.description:
Hi! My name is Carlos. I started building PP machines for plastic warriors in 2020. Since then, I have been able to build machines for nonprofits in New England & Puerto Rico, assist local institutions like Lincoln Labs & MIT with their research studies, and have joined forces with the Circular Economy Club of Boston and the Massachusetts Small Business Development Center at Clark University.
 
I truly believe PPNE has really great potential to become a leader in sustainability in New England and I am on a mission to make that a reality. Our mantra, SMERC, stands for Sustainable Manufacturing, Education, Research, and Community. By focusing our energy and growing our strengths on these 4 categories, PPNE will become the world's first state-of-the-art plastic recycling facility with its own research institute and community education center. Our Recycling Operations will look to focus on cleaning up areas throughout New England that pose a threat to wildlife & natural resources and re-purpose the plastic waste we collect into items that serve the local community. Our Research Institute will aim to provide New England with a center for studying the environmental effects of plastics and developing new innovative solutions for creating a sustainable future. Lastly, our Community Center will provide the public with a new option for recycling plastic with access to Precious Plastic Machines, Educational Workshops, and Community Events.

 
SMERC also represents our playful outlook on the future; "We take on the challenge of building a sustainable future with a smile!" because, in a world impacted by devastating environmental disasters and uncertainty, we stand tall and lead the way toward a sustainable future, today! We cannot afford to wait for something to happen. We must take charge and make things happen now! 

- Carlos Crespo, Founder, Precious Plastic New England


We are currently working on writing grant proposals and building relationships with sponsors and investors that could provide the capital necessary for our expansion plan. We will be posting updates soon for virtual and in-person events so look out for notifications on our Facebook & Instagram accounts!
data.title: Precious Plastic New England

We built the small Version 3.1 set of machines - Shredder, Compression Oven, Extruder and Injection machine.

data.description: The Good Plastic Company is an international manufacturer of surface materials that helps brands to make a visible commitment to sustainability.   Polygood is a range of 100% recycled and recyclable plastic panels that can be used to create modern-looking and environmentally-conscious furniture and interior or exterior design elements. Our distinctive Polygood panels can be used to create modern-looking environmentally-conscious furniture and interior or exterior design elements.  We believe that by generating demand for products made from recycled plastic we can keep this valuable material from ending up in landfill, the oceans, or incinerators. We demonstrate to companies that they can make beautiful and functional new goods from locally produced waste and make a visible commitment to the circular economy. Recycling centres process thousands of tonnes of plastic each month. However, uses for this recycled material remain limited. The Good Plastic Company’s Polygood panels enable new applications for this valuable resource. On the other side, businesses all around the world are implementing circular economy business models, driven by regulation and market demand. This sustainability transformation is a substantial challenge but also represents an opportunity for all companies in the value chain. Businesses need a tangible way to demonstrate shared values to their customers and enhance brand affinity. Incorporating recycled materials into retail and commercial interior implementations is a highly effective way for brands to make a powerful impression.
data.title: The Good Plastic Company

data.description: The New Raw crafts plastic waste with robots.   The New Raw is a research and design studio based in Rotterdam (Netherlands) founded in 2015 by architects Panos Sakkas and Foteini Setaki with the ambition to give new life to discarded materials through design, robots and craftsmanship.  The New Raw develops its own (digital) craftsmanship techniques through a formal and technical language that highlights the texture and the layer-by-layer character of its in-house robotic manufacturing process. The exploration of the possibilities that the robotic techniques provide transform plastic waste into beautiful and meaningful products that are 100% circular.

data.description: We are The Plastic Lotus, a Spanish couple who started a new workspace in Siem Reap, Cambodia. Siem Reap is a popular tourist destination that attracts millions of visitors every year, but it also faces a serious problem of waste management. Many people cannot afford to recycle their plastic waste, which accumulates all over the city. We have bought an industrial oven and we are waiting for the shredder and extruder from GB Manufactury India. Our goal is to transform plastic waste into valuable and eco-friendly furniture and souvenirs that can improve people's lives and support local artisans. We want to make furniture from recycled plastic and collaborate with local craftsmen who share our vision. We want to create a membership program for plastic collectors, where they can earn rewards for bringing us their plastic waste. We also want to pay more than what the market price for recycled plastic is, because we believe in its quality and potential.
data.title: Theplasticlotus

I would like to believe in a future in which our children learn to see the greater value in recycling plastic into useable things instead of feeding the dollar store mentality of "it's cheap, therefore I buy".

Handcrafted aims to empower those who have been disadvantaged or faced social exclusion due to crime, alcohol or substance abuse, poor mental or physical health, unemployment, or having experienced abuse or been in the care system. We work with individuals to help them make positive steps to turn their lives around, be part of a community and start to give back.We do this by:

Offering tailored training opportunities and creative activities for individuals to build confidence, gain skills and work towards their goals.
Providing holistic support that engages with individuals’ whole lives, helping them to build healthy coping strategies.
Providing supported housing across the region, renovating properties to make valuable homes that our residents can be proud to call their own.
Welcoming everyone into our community, regardless of background, and helping them see the value they bring.

We have recently started a new venture in plastic recycle as part of our work, we have plastic preneur gear, manual shredder and injector and molds. We collect, shred, melt, mold and create.

data.description:
The Department of Industrial Design is one of eight departments in the Faculty of Art, Design and Architecture based in a bespoke building on the UJ Bunting Road Campus.
The Department has four central principles that drive the education we offer:

As industrial designers we are responsible for the manufacture of products that will be produced in great numbers. We have a responsibility to consider the environmental impact of our creativity.
We are likely to design most of our products for just 10% of the world’s population who can afford designer consumer goods. However, we also have a responsibility to design products for the other 90% who may not be able to afford the luxury of the minority, but nevertheless need access to well-designed products in their everyday lives.
At the centre of what we are responsible for developing is the person who will one day use the results of our creativity. Every aspect of our design process needs to consider this individual and their circumstances as a priority.
We are located in Johannesburg, South Africa and should make every effort to reflect this unique context in how we design. This may be considered in terms of decolonization, development, identity, aesthetics, culture or social economics.
data.title: UJ Industrial Design

data.description:
Venti di Scambio is an association created in 2009 thanks to “PRINCIPI ATTIVI” a regional founding.
The goals are:
- promote social inclusion, active youth partecipation and european citizenship
- encourage solidarity, tollerance and understanding between different cultures
- create an increasing number of young people interested in European issues
- sensitize young people to respect the environment
The main activities of the organization are:
- Youth exchanges
- Trainign courses
- Languages courses
- Intercultural and environmental workshop
In all this years Venti di scambio made local workshops involving student, different group of immigrant, theachers and youth workers. At international level Venti di scambio organize youth exchanges and training courses linked with these topics.
From 2015 Venti di scambio manage the Info-Europa Desk; The aim is to inform young people about all the possibility of youth mobility that UE offer.
From January 2017 Venti di scambio is leader of an international group of associations in FAU project (Fabbricazione e Arte Urbana). The objectives of the project are: - the involvement of local communities on the themes of innovation and optimal use of local resources; - the production of digital manufacturing tools; - the acquisition and sharing of know-how on issues of innovation
and local craftsmanship.
In 2018  Venti di scambio opened “Spazio GAD”, a fabrications lab in Conversano.
Spazio GAD is a space dedicated to young people, entrepreneur, craftsmen and anyone who wants to learn, and create ideas, thanks to the continuous amount  of knowledge shared by the experts and experiences from all over the world. In Spazio GAD anyone can learn how to use the digital tools available (3D printers, 3D scanner, CNC pantograph, Arduino), but also machine tools for iron and woods craft. Here we started to collect plastic caps, we washes and selected. 
In 2021 we created CAOS LAB and we started to recicle plastic caps using different precious plastic machines.
In CAOS LAB we have: 
- 2 extruder to make 3D printer filaments
- 1 shredder
- 1 injector
CAOS LAB is a space open to all the citizen. People can just leave plastics or can learn how to recicle its.
data.title: Venti di scambio_Conversano

data.description:
Wacout is a waste collecting and recycling project by graduate students from a Climate-KIC Pre-incubation program, starting from 09/2019.

WHAT WE DO:
• Following our motto "WAste Collection OUTdoors is fun!", we organize waste collection events in combination with outdoor activities. Currently, we're running pilot events with kayaking in Utrecht area.
• Besides collection, we also do research on plastic recycling options. Our technical members are building a shredder in Switzerland and making prototypes in Germany. We cooperate with local Precious Plastic workspaces, from whom we have received various support!
• You can read more about us on our website: http://www.wacout.com.

OUR COLLECTION POINT:
• Besides organizing collecting activities, we're also collecting PET, PP and HDPE here in Utrecht to do more prototyping. It'd be more friendly with our humble student storage if the plastics you bring are cleaned and sorted :). We thank you for that!

Have a great day!
Wacout team.

data.description:
AT THE WANDERERS END SANCTUARY 
WE ARE A COMMUNITY OF PEOPLE DEDICATED TO DEMONSTRATING A CERTAIN KIND OF LIFESTYLE.
Call it “eco”, “eco-groovy”, “green”, “sustainable”, “mindful”, “small footprint”, or any of a number of other buzz words, the effect on our lives is the same: We each make it a point to live in a way that doesn’t use more than our share of resources or produce more byproduct than the systems of our environment (made by us or provided by nature) can process..

The Vision

Wanderers End Sanctuary aims to establish a thriving example of low-impact development by creating our sustainable community center providing an educational resource pointing the way for truly sustainable rural developments of the future. Precious Plastics ways of eliminating the concept of waste while also providing for our village and its surrounding community needs The land will be developed to improve the synergy of the different habitats across the site, simultaneously enhancing bio-diversity and leading to an increased but sustainable yield from the land. Where there will surely degraded agricultural pasture, Wanderers End Sanctuary and Gaian Living is empowering ecovillage residents to create a landscape of vitality and abundance.

data.description:
Waste Less Arugam Bay (WLAB) is an intervention into the booming coastal tourist destination of Arugam Bay in the Eastern Province of Sri Lanka. Our partnership with Development International Group (DIG) and the USAID Municipal Waste Recycling Program is a unique opportunity to not only establish a waste segregation system for plastics but also implement a new identity of Arugam Bay as a sustainable/green tourist destination. 
As a principle, the whole WLAB setup is housed in repurposed shipping containers to be easily moveable or reproducible. Proven a success the concept could be easily moved and/or reproduced in any tourist destination in Sri Lanka where the demand for waste management through tourism industry diminishes the waste management provided for local population, leading to illegal dumping and/or burning, both a short and long term health hazard.

data.description:
Welcome to Wecycle! 
Our non-profit organisation is composed of 18 members and was established early 2020. 
We are concerned changemakers that do not only want to make sure that plastic waste is collected but also that it is recycled locally. We take an active role in the acceleration of the local circularity of plastic and empowerment of the local community. 

Being charmed by the beauty of recycled plastic, we are exploring ways to make products with a meaning. We believe that we can more effectively change behaviours by making objects in recycled plastic that the general public can see and feel. Oslo already has a good system but there are still challenges we can tackle together! 

We currently have a double axis shredder, a compression machine and an injection machine. But also more exciting projects to come.
Fasten your recycled seat belts and join the adventure! 

Do not hesitate to contact us ;)

data.description:
I am a time served toolmaker with 45 years experience in a wide range of industries working with plastics, sheet metal, wire, leather etc.
I currently work as a design engineer using Solidworks CAD. I also do a great deal of 3D printing in ABS and PLA.
I have access to CNC milling, turning, wire edm etc.
As a hobby,  for the past 5 years, I have been making replica F1 steering wheels, which I have modelled myself from photos. You can see from my photo that I have had my wheels signed by many of the F1 drivers over the years.

I am excited to get involved in this project, as from the beginning of my 3D printing journey, I have wanted to do something about the recycling of the waste produced in the process.
My first step is to build a shredder so I can get the waste reduced into a manageable condition for further processing. The 3D printing community is working on recycling the printed material scrap for re-use in printing, but I would like to take it a step further. What that step is, I am not totally sure, but once I have made a start I will work on a continuous improvement philosophy and move forward from there.

I am keen to help and receive help in the true spirit of the green community.

data.description:
Part of WormingUp effort is to divert wastes away from the landfills by using upcycling machines to upcycle mainly plastic wastes into eco-products. Actively, we are involving our local rural community which has lack of waste management facilities to tackle the problem with managing their waste segregation and disposal through upcycling their wastes into eco-product that can serve as part of their local tourism products or household items. With Precious Plastic open sources, we were able to cater and provide various plastic upcycling solutions for our community not only by providing the machinery but also capacity building to uplift their skills.

[ABOUT US]
Fly Technology Agriculture Sdn Bhd (trademark: WormingUp) was established in 2015, founded by a group of young graduates who are passionate about environmental protection and conservation. We advocate for Sustainable Development Goal 12 - Responsible consumption and production. We started with organic waste management for eateries and today, we have expanded with more solutions on sustainability. We are a Malaysia accredited and tax-exempt Social Enterprise recognized by Ministry of Finance Malaysia (MoF) and Ministry of Entrepreneur Development and Cooperatives (MEDAC). We are also accredited and awarded as an innovative and environmentally driven organisation including ISO 14001, Environmental Award by Natural Resources and Environment Board Sarawak (NREB), a member of Global Waste Cleaning Network and Top Ten Innovators by Shell International.
data.title: WormingUp

data.description:
I'm 34 and used to work for the Louisiana highway department in Baton Rouge. I do different hands-on projects at home and with others. I support environmental stuff (collecting rain water for example). Feel free to send me a message to network. Calling and emailing work too. 1-225-221-2996. amhebert54+aq@gmail.com. 

I have a shredder and a bubble wrap popper that I use to make plastic that I generate more compact and manageable. I'm considering what's the best project for me to work on next. Note that I selected the mixed workspace option because I'm active in recycling, have at least one Precious Plastic tool, and have other tools that can be used for environmental work (woodworking, metalworking, gardening). 

I pick up trash off and on. Currently I only seperate metal cans when picking up trash because of the labor involved (the other stuff is too dirty for me to deal with currently). 

The Website link shows some of the CNC router projects that I've been involved with. I think it shows enough of the environmental work that I do to include here. 

I was a monthly donor to Precious Plastics. I had to readjust my expenses after resigning from my regular job. 

2020 Mar 08. I ordered a textbook named Polymer Recycling by John Scheirs. Lots of good information in it. Example: PVC floor coverings being cryogenically ground. This specific example isn't useful to me but having a book with this depth of information will be useful as I use it more. 

2023 Feb 02. Expanding the plastic recycling stuff that I have is still on my to do list. Projects like this take time to implement. 
I think that having my Baton Rouge map pin is useful because people occasionally contact me. It's generally just short messages, but I've made 1 to 2 good contacts.
data.title: Arthur Hebert

data.description: O CircuLar tem como objetivo promover a consciencialização e a experimentação sobre a economia circular nas comunidades de Sintra.
